case: finger hit sideways at the tip
note: bending + torsion at the tower root

case: Y pull on the 2 pin holes (magnet breakaway x2.5): bearing
note: 2x Ø3 pins pressed 8 mm

case: dock block: pin-hole bearing (magnet breakaway x2.5)
note: 2 holes, 6.8 long

case: dock block root (pins at z 58/65, root at the plate z 44)
note: block + foot 12 wide, 12.9 deep at the plate

case: nozzle hit sideways: pin-bore bearing
note: Ø3 steel pins carry the bending (σ ≈ 65 MPa in each pin at 15 N, hardened steel)

case: nozzle hit front/back: bore-end bearing
note: couple over ~15 mm of engagement, Ø3 pins

case: wire column: 20 N yank on the loom, root above the sleeve
note: 8 x 6.6, merged with the pin sleeve below z 52.9

case: wire column: same yank at the lower tie slot
note: slot 2.2 wide, 2.0 wall to the wire face

case: post knocked at the top (Y), above the buttress (z 64)
note: 9.7 x 5.4 post + 45 deg front buttress to z 65 (old 6.9 x 3.8 fin: 31 MPa)

case: finger force on the spine, column root (z 52)
note: a blocked lever is stopped by the body slot 6 mm below the contact, so the root never sees a large moment

case: pivot boss bearing (Ø3 pin, 8.4 long)
note: 2.0 wall round the pin

case: column root bending, closed spring load at the rod (root z 104)
note: 8.1 x 9.7 section, 20.8 mm lever

case: finger bending between the rod and the trip bar, idler fully open
note: 6.5 x 9.7 section; the bar pushes 9.5 mm above the rod, the rod pulls the other way

case: jammed guidler: the gantry pushes the finger into the bar until it stalls (root z 104)
note: 60 N is an assumed stall force; 8.1 x 9.7 column, 30.3 mm lever

case: finger tip knocked sideways (X) at z 147.5, root z 104
note: crash load on the most exposed point of the head

case: finger tip knocked front to back (Y) at z 147.5, root z 104
note: 9.7 deep section

case: screw-head washer bearing on the mast left face, idler open
note: Ø7 washer round the 3.4 mm slot

case: spring anchor root bending at the plate face, idler open
note: wall + top gusset, I = 306 mm4; load on the ridge 6.4 mm in front of the plate

case: spring anchor: washer bearing on the ridge
note: two 1.7 mm strips beside the slot, about 1.5 mm of flattened ridge

case: tower root bending, idler open (bar load at z 134, foot top at z 76)
note: 24 x 20 tower; printed on its left face so the load runs in the layer plane

case: bar bending at the tower, load at the far end of the flat (48 mm out)
note: 16 x 7 bar

case: tower torsion from the offset bar load
note: shear, 24 x 20 section

case: foot bending beside the tower (ribs ignored)
note: 20 x 6 foot; the two 3.5 mm ribs add to this

case: bar tip knocked sideways (X), 67 mm from the tower
note: crash load

case: bar tip pushed down (Z), 67 mm from the tower
note: handling load

case: deflection at the finger under the full opening load
note: about 0.4 mm (bar 0.17, tower twist 0.16, tower bend 0.03 at E = 2 GPa): 3 % of the 12.7 mm travel; slide the arm along the rail to trim it
